Through a large window behind him sprawls the neon nightscape of a cyberpunk megacity — towering skyscrapers awash in magenta, pink, cyan, and amber signage including a vivid 'ネオ東京' billboard, hovering vehicles streaking through rainy canyons of light. upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A cinematic oil-painting style nocturne in which Vincent van Gogh stands alone at the center of a vast, undulating golden wheat field beneath a sky pulled directly from his own imagination. The thin, gaunt painter wears a simple dark coat, his auburn hair and short red beard catching the cool radiance from above as he tilts his head back to gaze into the heavens. Above him, the night sky burns and churns with enormous luminous stars haloed in concentric yellow rings, monumental spiral nebulae swirling in cobalt, teal, and violet, and rivers of turbulent ultramarine cloud spiraling across the firmament. The ripe ears of wheat below mirror the sky, their countless bristles glinting with reflected starlight as they ripple like a sea. Strong chiaroscuro contrasts illuminate Van Gogh's haunted face — pale, hollow-cheeked, his blue-green eyes shining with a mixture of deep melancholy and almost frenzied creative passion. Every surface is built from thick, visible impasto brushstrokes, lending the entire image the tactile presence of a Post-Impressionist canvas while retaining a cinematic depth and emotional narrative tension, as if the universe itself were burning at the tip of his brush.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A magnificent wide-angle interior view of the Roman Colosseum at midday, captured from an elevated vantage on one of the surviving tiers. The massive elliptical stone walls curve around the entire frame, their travertine surfaces mottled, pitted, and damaged by two thousand years of erosion. Broken arcades, crumbled cornices, and an incomplete upper attic open onto fragments of a pale bright sky. The vaulted ceiling above is shattered in places, allowing the vertical midday sun to pour through the gaps in distinct, parallel Tyndall beams that slice through the dusty air. These golden shafts converge upon the center of the arena, illuminating a patch of sand into a glowing amber pool. Below, the excavated hypogeum is exposed, a maze-like network of underground passages, holding cells, and corridors arranged in concentric and radial geometries. Slivers of sunlight spill onto select fragments of these subterranean walls, creating a stark chiaroscuro contrast against the deep shadows that engulf the rest of the labyrinth. The overall scene is bathed in warm ochres and creams set against charcoal darkness, evoking a solemn, awe-inspiring atmosphere imbued with the historical vicissitude and silent grandeur of antiquity.

Their bodies are constructed of brushed silver-gray metal armor with intricate hydraulic pipelines, exposed pistons, and braided cables at the joints; their ears are pointed and antenna-tipped, their tails segmented like industrial conduits. The fox on the left is fully active, its right ocular lens emitting a sharp cyan glow that throws a soft teal rim light across its facial plates. The fox on the right mirrors its twin in every structural detail, but its eyes are pitch black and dim, lifeless, suggesting it has been disconnected or shut down. Rain beads on both their armored backs. The composition is center-weighted and symmetrical, shot at a low eye-level with shallow depth of field, the foxes in crisp focus while the neon-drenched skyscrapers and reflective puddles dissolve into atmospheric haze. The overall mood is melancholic, mysterious, and electric—a quintessential cyberpunk tableau of paired sentinels in a rain-soaked neon metropolis.

Right beside him on the right, an adult figure - cropped from the lower jaw down, dressed in a charcoal knit sweater - stands close, holding in both reverently cupped hands a cold, extinguished model of the sun. The deep dark background dissolves into negative space, drawing all attention to the intimate pairing of the two figures and their two suns: one alive and roaring with creation, one silent and ashen with extinction. Cinematic chiaroscuro lighting, shallow depth of field, painterly fantasy realism. Square 1:1 framing.

He cradles a small smoothly polished wooden sculpture in both hands at chest height, gazing down at it with quiet reverence. Beside him, slightly behind and to the right, stands a tall young apprentice in his early twenties, with tousled dark brown hair, warm olive skin, faint stubble, and dark attentive eyes. He wears a beige canvas apron over a white shirt with rolled sleeves and leans forward and downward over his master's shoulder, his lips slightly parted as he studies the carving with focused curiosity. The ochre plastered back wall is densely hung with rows of iron chisels, gouges, hand planes, and saws on hand-forged hooks, while a massive aged oak workbench on the right is scattered with curled wood shavings, an unfinished block of pale wood, a brass-handled mallet, and a small jar of linseed oil. The terracotta tile floor is lightly dusted with sawdust. The cinematic chiaroscuro lighting bathes the two figures and the sculpture in honeyed warmth, while the workshop edges fade into soft amber shadow, evoking a timeless, intimate moment of craftsmanship being passed from master to apprentice. Shot in shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the sculpture and master's face, in the painterly tradition of Caravaggio.

The entire sculpture wears a layered patina in shifting shades of verdigris green, deep umber, and warm copper, streaked and pooled by decades of weathering, lending the piece a profound sense of time-worn gravitas. Dramatic museum-quality lighting from the upper left rakes across the sculpture, modeling every curl, fabric fold, and ornate book spine, while a soft neutral background lets the figure and the levitating watch dominate. The composition is centered and slightly low-angled, emphasizing monumentality, with shallow depth of field focusing on Einstein's contemplative face. The mood is intellectually weighty, timeless, and quietly surreal — a meditation on genius, knowledge, and the curvature of spacetime.

A thin layer of fresh snow dusts the bank and clings to the upper sides of the larger limbs. The composition is centered and quietly symmetrical, evoking a profound sense of solitude, dormancy, and the visual echo between heaven and earth in the heart of a windless winter.

Their gloved hand reaches with desperate urgency toward a small wooden family photo frame that tumbles slowly through the air just beyond their fingertips, the vaguely visible portrait of a smiling woman and two children glinting through its glass. The astronaut's face, framed by the clear visor of a soft-shell helmet, wears an expression of anxious longing — wide dark eyes, furrowed brow, parted lips. In the center foreground, a humanoid robot with a scratched and dented metal shell sits slumped on a pile of broken concrete and rusted debris. Its optical sensors glow only dimly with a faint amber flicker, and its posture is heavy with loneliness, head tilted back as it gazes sadly up at the hazy heavens. High in the sky to the upper right, a sleek brand-new spaceship of polished white-silver alloy ascends powerfully, emitting a bright cyan-blue tail flame and a crisp ionized trail. The contrast between the two ships mirrors the contrast between the gleaming future leaving and the decaying past being left behind, all witnessed by the silent, abandoned robot in the wide, melancholic ruins. Cinematic concept art lighting with deep focus, muted dystopian palette, and painterly realism.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A wide cinematic concept illustration of a once-prosperous wooden city reduced to charred ruins after a great fire. In the very center of the frame, a single stone clock tower stands tall and intact, its grey ashlar walls blackened with soot and its tarnished clock face still visible near the top. All around it sprawls a vast field of devastation: collapsed timber-framed buildings, scorched wooden beams jutting at twisted angles, splintered planks, and a thick blanket of pale grey ash covering the ground where streets and homes once stood. Wisps of smoke curl lazily upward through the dim, ash-darkened twilight sky, while deep within the rubble, scattered embers pulse with a faint red-orange glow, casting subtle warm light onto the surrounding wreckage. The composition is centrally symmetrical, with the vertical tower anchoring the horizontal expanse of ruins. The palette is dominated by charcoal blacks, ashen greys, and smoky whites, accented by mournful ember reds. The mood is desolate, tragic, and hauntingly silent — a solemn monument to a city consumed by flame.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A surreal hyperreal digital illustration of a vast caramel-colored desert under a punishing dark chocolate sun. Across the toffee-glazed sands stand the ranks of an entire Terracotta Army of Qin Shi Huang, but every warrior is sculpted from multicolored candies — rock-candy helmets, layered rainbow hard-candy armor, gummy belts, licorice greaves, and licorice spears. The colossal cocoa sun in the upper sky cracks and weeps molten chocolate, its surface flowing with liquid cocoa rivulets, radiating scorching waves of heat that ripple the air. Under this brutal warmth, the candy soldiers are collapsing: front-rank figures have already slumped into glossy puddles of pink, violet, lime, and amber syrup; mid-rank warriors sag forward, their hard-candy armor losing sharp edges, helmets sliding, licorice spears bowing like soft noodles. Their candy-bean eyes are wide with despair, and their once-solemn mouths are warped downward into agonized frowns by the heat. Viscous, colorful syrup drips from every figure, mingling into a chaotic, swirling pool of sugar across the caramel sand. The composition is a slightly low-angle wide shot, deeply focused, with glistening highlights and long syrup-stained shadows, evoking a darkly whimsical, sweetly apocalyptic tragedy.

The background is a large area of blank space, with only a few light ink washes in the distance depicting mist, creating a spacious and solitary atmosphere.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A traditional Chinese ink wash painting on Xuan rice paper, suffused with Zen stillness. Off-center in the lower portion of the composition, a plump, round-bodied penguin stands quietly atop a small floating ice floe with softly melting edges. Its back and head are rendered in rich, moist dark ink with subtle tonal bleeds, while its white belly is cleverly defined by the untouched blankness of the paper itself. The penguin shows no panic — it bows its head gently and gazes with focused, curious eyes downward at the mirror-calm water below, where its own reflection appears as a softer, lighter ink echo, creating a quiet contrast between reality and illusion. The floating ice is outlined in pale ink and textured with delicate dry-brush strokes that form a cracked, fissured pattern across its surface. Surrounding the subject is a vast expanse of blank paper, broken only by a few extremely pale ink washes in the far distance suggesting drifting mist. The overall mood is spacious, solitary, and meditative — a monochromatic study in black ink and negative space evoking solitude, self-reflection, and the philosophical tranquility of Chan Buddhism.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A cinematic square photograph set in a dimly lit urban alley at dusk. His brows are deeply furrowed, his tired hazel eyes gaze blankly off to the side, and his lips press into a thin line, his face filled with unspeakable sorrow. Light stubble, faint gray strands in his dark hair, and shadowed under-eyes deepen the impression of quiet heartbreak. Directly behind him runs a rough, weathered concrete wall, on which a single line of English is scrawled in uneven black spray paint: 'Sometimes, we create our own heartbreak through expectation.' Beyond the wall, rendered in a soft shallow depth of field, a young woman in her late twenties stands in the upper-right background. Her chestnut wavy hair tumbles back as she tilts her head upward, eyes closed, mouth open in a hearty, joyful laugh, wearing a light cream blouse. Cool ambient streetlight blends with a warm rim glow, casting soft shadows and creating a moody chiaroscuro. The desaturated palette of charcoal grays, muted browns, and cool blues, combined with the layered composition of foreground sorrow, central message, and background joy, evokes a melancholic, bittersweet, narrative atmosphere of emotional contrast and self-inflicted longing.

A few cacti of varying heights are actually the dark green spines of ancient books, with faded gold embossed titles still remaining. In the distance, at the edge of the desert, lies a black ink lake as calm as a mirror. A weathered wooden sign stands solitarily by the lake, with 'Fountain of Inspiration' handwritten on it in clear ink.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A vast, surreal desert rendered in painterly photorealism, where the terrain is built entirely from countless fragments of yellowed, brittle paper printed with black text, their edges curled and worn, piled into rolling sepia-toned dunes. A surgeon's pale-lavender-blue gloved right hand grips a stainless steel Mayo-Hegar needle holder with gold finger rings, driving a curved cutting needle and glossy black suture thread through the dermis, while the left gloved hand wields fine-toothed Adson forceps to stabilize the tissue. A small pool of saline tinged faintly pink glistens beside the wound. Intense cool-white overhead OR lights produce a near-shadowless, high-key clinical illumination, glinting on the metallic instruments, the wet tissue, and the subtle micro-texture of the gloves. Along the bottom edge of the frame, a stainless steel instrument table intrudes, holding folded white gauze squares lightly stained with pink, curved Metzenbaum scissors, and a hemostat. The depth of field is shallow, with crisp focus on the needle, suture thread, and glove fingertips, while the deeper OR fades into a soft chrome-and-white blur. The mood is tense, focused, and meticulously sterile.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photoreal wide laboratory photograph captured at bench height inside a stainless-steel fume hood. Two round-bottom borosilicate flasks sit on white ceramic-topped hot plates, each holding a clear liquid in a vigorous rolling boil with rapid streams of bubbles. Vertical Allihn glass condensers are clamped to a tall metal lattice stand directly above the flasks, with bright blue silicone coolant tubing looping out to a recirculator at the side. Wisps of steam fog the lower glass, and fine droplets condense inside the cylindrical condenser jackets. In the background, a row of amber reagent bottles with white hazard labels lines the back wall, a slender digital thermometer probe dips into one flask, and a shallow black spill containment tray sits beneath the apparatus. Bright, cool fume-hood lighting casts even illumination, producing crisp specular reflections on the glassware and metal hardware, while a slight chemical haze drifts through the air. The composition is symmetrical and clinical, framed at eye level with shallow depth of field focusing on the boiling flasks and condenser bulbs.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic photograph of a widescreen computer monitor sitting on a dim, cool-lit desk in a glaciology analyst's workspace. The screen is filled by a geospatial dashboard titled 'Glacier Retreat Monitor', presenting a split-screen satellite image comparison. The left panel, stamped '1985-08-12' in the top-left, shows a broad white glacier tongue flowing through a dark mountain valley, its margin carefully traced by a thin cyan polyline. The right panel, stamped '2024-08-10', shows the same valley decades later: the ice has dramatically receded, leaving exposed gray bedrock, brown lateral moraines, and a small turquoise meltwater pond, with a bold orange line marking the current glacier terminus and a faint cyan ghost outline indicating the former extent. Along the right side of the screen, a vertical zoom slider with plus and minus buttons sits above a column of layer checkboxes labeled 'Ice extent (historic)', 'Current terminus', 'Moraine', and 'Hillshade', each paired with a small color swatch. Tiny scale bars reading '1 km' anchor the lower-left of each panel. The room is cool and dim; soft overhead lighting and the bluish glow of the screen produce subtle reflections across the glossy display, while a black keyboard, mouse, and coffee mug sit faintly visible at the bottom edge of the frame. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with cyan and vivid orange accents providing the only saturated color against an otherwise muted, sober palette—an evocative, documentary-style image of climate monitoring in practice.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic, slightly angled photograph of a widescreen workstation monitor in a dimly lit office, the screen filled with a grayscale synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite image of open sea. In the upper-right corner of the screen, a small inset map shows a stylized coastline in pale blue-gray with a red footprint box marking the scene's location. Along the bottom edge of the display, crisp white monospaced text reads the latitude and longitude coordinates and the acquisition timestamp, with a horizontal grayscale intensity bar and σ0 [dB] tick labels in the lower-left. Soft warm ambient light spills from above-left onto the matte black bezel, while the cool glow of the screen dominates the room. Faint moiré banding from the camera sensor crosses the mid-tones of the SAR image. The shallow depth of field keeps the on-screen imagery and metadata text in sharp focus, with the surrounding desk—corner of a keyboard, a coffee mug rim, a stack of papers—softly defocused. The mood is quiet, technical, and analytical, evoking a maritime remote-sensing analyst's late-shift workstation.

The on-screen imagery suggests bright tropical midday sun with minimal shadowing, but the surrounding room is dim, with a faint glare on the upper-right of the monitor and the desk fading into near-black shadow. The overall mood is analytical and contemplative, with the glowing reef imagery serving as the lone vibrant light source in a quiet research environment.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic, slightly wide-angle photograph taken at waist height looking down a long warehouse aisle. The polished gray concrete floor is marked with painted yellow safety lanes and bears the hard-edged shadows of equipment lit by overhead high-bay LED fixtures whose warm-white beams catch drifting dust motes in the air. Tall steel pallet racking flanks the aisle, loaded with shrink-wrapped inventory and additional cardboard cartons rising into the distance. In the center foreground, a heavy wooden GMA pallet rests on the concrete, supporting a neat, columnar stack of brown corrugated cardboard shipping boxes arranged two-by-two and three layers tall, with a fourth box currently being lowered into place. Each box bears a printed white shipping label with a tracking number, a black barcode, and red stenciled handling instructions, and clear packing tape runs along the center seams. A six-axis industrial palletizing robot arm in safety yellow with black servo housings sweeps in from the upper right of the frame, its articulated joints flexed and its round vacuum-cup end-effector pressed flat against the top of the box being placed. A blue 'AISLE 7' sign hangs in the background above the racking. The palette is dominated by warm kraft browns, safety yellow, charcoal concrete, and steel silver, with strong top-down lighting producing crisp shadow lines and a clean, methodical industrial atmosphere of quiet automated precision.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic interior photograph taken at eye level inside a quiet public library wing. Three of its articulated legs are planted firmly while the other three lift mid-step, the multi-jointed limbs bending precisely to balance on the uneven rubble. A small red status LED glows on its side, and a forward-mounted stereo camera and LIDAR puck scan ahead. In the background, a partially collapsed brick wall leans with exposed rebar jutting out, and a torn strip of yellow CAUTION tape flutters from a bent post. Shot handheld on a wide 28mm lens close to the ground, the composition feels gritty, urgent, and photojournalistic, with shallow depth of field keeping the robot's front legs and sensor head razor-sharp while the collapsed wall softens behind. The palette is dominated by desaturated greys, dust beige, and brick orange-red, punctuated by the muted yellow of the hazard tape.

Clinging to one of the I-beams is a spider-like inspection robot with eight articulated carbon-fiber legs, a matte-black hexagonal chassis marked 'BR-07', and twin LED work lights casting hard white highlights across bolts, rivets, and corroded steel. Deep depth of field keeps both the robot and the surrounding architecture in sharp focus.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic close-up manufacturing photograph of a horizontal injection molding machine captured mid-cycle. The mold halves are fully opened, revealing the precision-machined tooling and a glossy black plastic part still seated on the ejector side. Six steel ejector pins are extended, pushing the part outward, while a short cylindrical sprue protrudes from its top surface. Heavy steel platens and four chrome tie bars frame the action, their surfaces glistening with a faint film of machine oil. At the right edge of the frame, a transparent polycarbonate safety guard door with a red interlock sensor and a small yellow warning decal is partially visible. Warm amber overhead lighting mixes with cool cyan machine-mounted LEDs, producing dramatic specular highlights on the mirror-finish black part and crisp reflections across the oily steel. Faint wisps of steam rise from the warm tooling. The composition is tight and slightly off-center, with shallow depth of field freezing the moment in sharp detail on the mold texture, ejector pins, and gleaming part surface, evoking an atmosphere of industrial precision and mechanical drama.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic high-angle photograph taken from an elevated catwalk inside a modern recycling facility, looking down the length of a production line. A long black ribbed rubber conveyor belt carries a dense, colorful layer of mixed recycled plastic flakes toward and beneath an overhead optical sorting unit, whose stainless and blue powder-coated housings contain glowing sensor strips and a row of pneumatic air-jet manifolds with braided hoses. Puffs of compressed air launch individual flakes off the belt, separating them mid-flight into three streams - vivid blue, leafy green, and translucent clear - that arc into polished stainless steel chutes and accumulate as distinct mounded piles in heavy-duty gray and yellow collection bins on the gray concrete floor. Harsh white high-bay LED lighting from above produces crisp specular reflections on the metal guards and casts hard short shadows; fine dust motes drift through the beams of light. Yellow-and-black safety railings line the catwalk in the foreground, while warning signage including a yellow 'CAUTION - MOVING PARTS' placard, a blue 'PPE REQUIRED BEYOND THIS POINT' notice, and a stenciled 'LINE 3' label punctuate the machinery. The deep one-point perspective of the receding conveyor draws the eye through the clinical, industrious atmosphere of stainless steel, black rubber, and saturated plastic colors against neutral concrete and steel.

Warm, low golden sunlight rakes in from the right, casting long striped shadows of the gantry across the slab and igniting motes of construction dust drifting through the air. The cloudy sky is broken by shafts of sun, lending an atmospheric, industrial-futurist mood to the scene. In the distance, cement bags on a pallet, a small silo and pump, and the silhouettes of framed neighboring houses complete the active jobsite. The palette balances cool concrete grays with safety-yellow steel and warm amber light, capturing additive construction technology in vivid documentary detail.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic wide shot taken from waist height inside a sunlit carpentry shop in the late afternoon. Warm shafts of sunlight pierce through high clerestory windows, illuminating airborne sawdust drifting above a long light-oak tabletop that rests on two black steel trestles. On the right, a white and light-grey six-axis collaborative robot arm, mounted to a rolling cart, holds a yellow-and-black round orbital sander flat against the wood, its dust port connected to a flexible black hose. The sander moves in slow overlapping circular passes, leaving fine pale sawdust accumulating along the grain. Its yellow power cord drapes off the table edge toward the dusty concrete floor, where bar clamps and a coiled shop-vac hose lie nearby. To the left stands an adult male woodworker in his mid-thirties, wearing red over-ear hearing protection, clear safety glasses, a heather-grey henley with rolled sleeves, and a dark canvas work apron. He cradles a tablet showing a dark dashboard with 'SPEED' and 'PRESSURE' gauges and a green 'RUNNING' status pill, his expression calm and focused. Behind them, exposed wooden roof trusses, pegboards of hand tools, a lumber rack, and a tall red shop vacuum recede into a hazy, golden-lit background. The image features crisp wood pores, a matte oak finish, mild natural lens barrel distortion, and a deep depth of field, conveying quiet, industrious human-robot collaboration.

On the left, a focused adult male technician in a navy work shirt, gray cargo pants, blue nitrile-coated gloves, and clear safety glasses holds a second matching screwdriver mid-handoff, ready to drive the next fastener in an alternating human-robot screwdriving routine. The mood is precise, collaborative, and modern, capturing the seamless choreography of human and machine on an appliance assembly line.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic, documentary-style photograph captured at shoulder height inside a modern hospital operating room during a knee surgery. A surgeon in teal-blue scrubs, surgical cap, white mask, sterile gown, and nitrile gloves leans over the patient from the left side of the frame, eyes narrowed in concentration above the mask. The patient lies fully covered by surgical green drapes except for the right knee, which is exposed through a fenestrated window, prepped with amber povidone-iodine, and bears a small, neat linear incision with minimal bleeding. Arching in from the right, a compact white-and-grey collaborative robot arm — fully sheathed in a clear sterile sleeve cinched at the joints with sterile tape — stabilizes a self-retaining retractor while positioning a slim suction tip near the incision. Twin overhead surgical lamps cast intense, near-shadowless white light on the operative field, while the rest of the room glows in cool, muted blue-grey tones. In the soft background, ceiling-mounted flat-panel monitors display an orthopedic X-ray and a vital-signs waveform, and a stainless-steel instrument table at the right edge holds neatly arrayed tools in shallow focus. The composition is shot on a 50mm-equivalent lens with a shallow depth of field that locks crisp focus on the surgeon's hands, the incision, and the cobot's end effector, producing a tense, clinical, technologically advanced atmosphere of precise human–robot collaboration. The square 1:1 frame renders at 1024 by 1024 pixels.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic, chest-height photograph taken from a slight right angle inside an industrial training bay on a manufacturing shop floor. On the left, an adult male worker in his mid-30s with short dark hair, light stubble, and clear safety glasses wears a navy blue short-sleeve work shirt with a company patch and an ID badge, plus dark utility trousers. He stands in a focused posture, right arm extended, index finger lightly touching a wall- or stand-mounted touchscreen that displays a glowing user interface labeled 'PICK POINTS' with a 3x4 grid of selectable cells (one highlighted in green) and a coordinate readout 'X: 245.6  Y: 132.4  Z: 78.0' beneath it. The fingertip and the subtle reflections on the glossy screen are in razor-sharp focus. Beside and slightly behind him, a white-and-gray six-axis collaborative robot arm with a two-finger parallel gripper is paused mid-air, its soft blue status LED glowing, the gripper aligned diagonally toward a heavy metal parts rack on the right. The rack holds neat rows of small gray and beige plastic bins, each marked with colored tags in green, red, yellow, and blue, slightly softened by shallow depth of field. The polished concrete floor is marked with yellow-and-black taped lanes delineating walkways and the robot work cell, and a yellow caution placard reading 'CAUTION ROBOT WORK CELL' is faintly visible in the blurred background among other machinery and overhead cable trays. Cool overhead fluorescent troffer lighting bathes the scene in even, slightly cyan-tinted illumination, casting soft short shadows and producing crisp specular highlights on the touchscreen, the robot's smooth shell, and the worker's safety glasses. The composition follows the rule of thirds, with the worker on the left, the cobot center, and the rack on the right, conveying a focused, professional atmosphere of human-robot collaboration training.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic wide-angle photograph taken at conveyor-belt height inside a bustling modern recycling facility. A long rubberized belt runs horizontally from left to right across the frame, its surface and the mixed recyclables atop it streaked with directional motion blur. On the near side, an adult worker in a hi-vis yellow vest with reflective stripes, navy long-sleeve shirt, blue cut-resistant gloves, white hard hat, and clear safety glasses leans in from the left foreground; their right gloved hand, rendered in tack-sharp focus, grips a crushed aluminum can mid-air as they prepare to drop it into a labeled metal chute marked 'ALUMINUM ONLY'. On the far side of the belt, a white-and-orange six-axis collaborative robot arm extends diagonally, its parallel-jaw gripper—also crisply in focus—holding a clear PET plastic bottle just lifted from the belt, with a small green status LED glowing on its base and a yellow 'CAUTION — AUTOMATED EQUIPMENT' sticker on the adjacent safety rail. Tubular safety-yellow railings, weathered warning decals, and rows of blue and green collection bins (one labeled 'PLASTIC #1 PET') frame the scene. Overhead, a mix of warm sodium-vapor lamps and cool white LED panels casts amber highlights and bluish shadows; visible dust motes drift through volumetric light shafts, and exposed steel trusses, catwalks, and stacked cardboard bales recede into a softly blurred background. The composition emphasizes human-robot collaboration with cinematic shallow depth of field, an industrial color palette of yellow, navy, grey, and orange, and a hopeful, industrious atmosphere. upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic, high-security industrial photograph taken from inside a sealed nuclear hot cell control booth. Through a thick, slightly amber-tinted leaded glass viewport set in a stainless-steel frame, the hot cell chamber is revealed: poured-concrete walls in pale institutional gray, a stencil reading 'HOT CELL 3,' and bold yellow-and-black 'CAUTION RADIOACTIVE MATERIAL' placards bearing magenta trefoils. A bright safety-yellow KUKA-style six-axis teleoperated robot arm with black accordion joint covers extends across the chamber, its stainless steel pneumatic claw delicately holding a small metallic sample container above a polished stainless work surface. Cool overhead fluorescent lighting casts flat, slightly greenish-blue tones across both spaces, producing soft low-contrast shadows and clinical reflections on every dust-free surface. Shot at 70mm with shallow depth of field, the camera frames the scene through the booth window, sharp on the joystick and hand and softening gracefully into the robot arm beyond the glass, emphasizing the layered depth between joystick, glass barrier, and manipulator. The atmosphere is tense, sterile, and meticulously controlled.

Soft haze catches the screen light, deep shadows pool between aisles, and a deep depth of field keeps both the operator's hands and the layered screen wall in crisp focus, conveying a tense, focused, high-tech teleoperation rehearsal.

upsampled_prompt.background_setting: A photorealistic interior of a modern astronaut training facility. Gray foam-padded acoustic wall panels arranged in a quilted square grid line the back and side walls. Bright industrial LED panels mounted on a metal grid ceiling cast even, clinical lighting. To the right, a large flat-panel monitor on an articulated wall mount displays a simulated 3D rendering: a robotic manipulator arm extending along the truss segment of a space station, with the curved blue limb of Earth, swirling white clouds, and the blackness of space behind it. A bulky black VR helmet with a glossy tinted visor covers their head, its tethered cable trailing down to a coiled harness on the polished concrete floor. The composition is balanced via the rule of thirds, deep depth of field keeps both operator and simulation crisp, and the mood is focused, technical, and futuristic.

The image is shot on a 70mm telephoto lens, compressing the distance between farmer and machine, with shallow depth of field keeping the farmer's hands and phone screen in crisp focus while the tractor remains legibly soft. upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: Photorealistic dashcam point-of-view image looking forward through a slightly curved windshield onto a multi-lane freeway under a heavy overcast sky. In the middle ground, a multi-car pileup blocks two lanes: a white SUV sits angled across the left lane with its rear end crushed, tail lights shattered and bumper hanging loose, while a dark charcoal sedan is wedged just behind it with a violently buckled hood, cracked windshield, and deployed airbags visible inside. Light gray smoke and steam rise vertically between the two wrecked vehicles. Plastic debris, a detached side mirror, and fluid streaks litter the wet, dark asphalt, and curved skid marks lead into the crash. On the right shoulder, a black-and-white police cruiser is parked at an angle with its light bar flashing alternating red and blue, the colors reflecting brightly off the damp pavement. In the remaining open right lane, a slow line of cautious traffic—compact cars and a silver crossover with brake lights glowing—creeps past the scene. Low concrete Jersey barriers, a metal guardrail, sparse leafless trees, and utility poles flank the freeway, with a distant green highway sign visible against the flat gray horizon. A small white digital timestamp '12:47' is overlaid in the bottom-right corner, and 'POLICE' lettering is visible on the cruiser's door. The diffuse overcast lighting mutes the overall palette to grays and dark tones, making the saturated emergency strobes and the white SUV stand out sharply, evoking a tense, somber, urgent atmosphere.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic first-person dashcam photograph captured through a vehicle's windshield during an intense hailstorm on a suburban arterial road. Beyond the glass, the suburban two-lane road stretches into a hazy, desaturated distance, its asphalt slick and metallic with standing water that reflects the dim slate-gray sky. Three pairs of oncoming headlights bloom into soft warm halos through the wet, refractive surface, the only bright accents amid the gloom. Low commercial buildings, utility poles, and bare trees are reduced to ghostly silhouettes behind curtains of wind-driven spray, and a faint red traffic signal glows in the distance. Visibility is short and choked with mist. The dashboard's dark rim frames the bottom of the image, with a small white digital timestamp reading '10:47 AM 03/14' in the lower-left corner and a 'SPEED 38 MPH' overlay in the lower-right. The composition is centered and symmetrical, evoking a tense, hazardous, and visceral atmosphere of severe weather driving, rendered in a palette dominated by charcoal grays, slate blues, and wet asphalt blacks accented by icy whites and warm amber halos.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic dashcam point-of-view image, captured through the windshield of an SUV crawling along a remote unpaved country road after heavy rainfall. Concentric ripples spread outward across the puddles from the vehicle's slow forward motion. Between and alongside the ruts, ridges of slick wet clay rise in soft mounds, streaked with tire impressions. Tall, rain-soaked grass droops along both shoulders, and weathered gray wooden fence posts strung with sagging wire recede into the distance on either side, reinforcing a strong one-point perspective. Beyond the fields, a damp fog softens the silhouettes of distant broadleaf trees into muted gray-blue shapes against a uniformly overcast sky. The cool, even daylight produces almost no hard shadows but lights up glossy specular reflections on the muddy water and the wet ridges of clay. The lower portion of the windshield is dotted with flecks of mud and small water droplets, with faint wiper arcs visible, and the very bottom edge of the frame hints at the dark dashboard interior. The overall palette is muted earth tones - chocolate browns, olive grasses, and silver-gray fog - evoking a damp, isolated, quietly atmospheric rural scene. Three cars - silver sedan, dark blue SUV, white compact - are parked along the right curb. The low golden-hour sun rakes in from the front-left, casting long diagonal tree shadows in rhythmic bands across the asphalt and warming the brick facade with amber light, while the retroreflective sign and beacons read vividly. Subtle camera vibration, slight rolling-shutter wobble, mild lens flare, and a faint dashboard reflection along the bottom edge confirm the dashcam medium. The atmosphere is calm, cautionary, and warmly nostalgic of a small-town afternoon dismissal.

The funnel directs the ball into a graceful arc of twelve glossy black-and-white dominoes that have just begun to topple. The lever swings to strike a tin bucket on a pivoting cradle, which is mid-tilt, marbles cascading out onto the workbench. Mixed materials are visible throughout — plywood ramps, aluminum rails, rubber bands, brass screws, masking-tape labels reading 'STAGE 1' and 'STAGE 2', and improvised taped joints. Overhead fluorescent lighting bathes the scene in cool, even illumination, casting soft shadows directly beneath each component. The camera is positioned at a three-quarter angle slightly above the bench, with deep depth of field rendering every stage of the machine readable while a pegboard wall of slightly out-of-focus tools — wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, a coil of wire — fills the background. The mood is inventive, playful, and full of tinker-shop charm.

upsampled_prompt.comprehensive_t2i_caption: A photorealistic dashcam-style image captured from a low, forward-facing camera on a rainy highway shoulder. The wet asphalt shoulder reflects the flat overcast sky in long mirror-like smears, with a crisp white edge line running parallel to the barrier. Three orange-and-white reflective traffic cones stand in a loose row in front of the damage, marking the hazard zone, and a blurred dark sedan is stopped further down the road, faint amber hazard lights glowing through the mist. The lighting is soft, diffuse, and desaturated, producing muted grays, cool steel tones, and only the cones offering vivid color. Composition is wide-angle with mild barrel distortion, deep depth of field keeping the buckled plastic geometry razor sharp while atmospheric haze blurs the background. The mood is somber, tense, and documentary, evoking the aftermath of a minor highway incident.
